issues.description: Rideable.messageOnRide parameter mismatch: The problem statement/UML and the template Main expect a no-argument method messageOnRide() that returns a string like "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]". The solution repository instead declares messageOnRide(String equipment) in Rideable and implements messageOnRide(String equipment) in Pig and Seal. This mismatch will cause compilation errors (Main calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments) and confuses students which signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method signature across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to match the problem statement and template by defining Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters and update Pig and Seal to implement public String messageOnRide() returning exactly "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" (e.g., "Riding on Pig Doodle"). Alternative: if an equipment parameter is intended, update the problem statement/UML and the template Main to require messageOnRide(String equipment), show how to call it in Main, and document the expected return format.
